name: Undo
author: byo-pop
description: Ctrl+Z or U takes back your last move: the pair you joined (or the puzzle swap), with the animals, the score and the combo as they were. The flood does not go back with it, so a take-back costs time. Only within a level. Games with it keep their own high scores and saved game.

settings.label: Moves that can be undone
settings.help: How many of the level's last moves can be taken back, one after another.

settings.label: The water goes back too
settings.help: Off: the flood keeps its level when you undo, so undoing costs time. On: the water level of that moment comes back as well.
